policy: This MVP stores source-linked summary records for explanation and map labels. It is not a complete case database, not a live feed, and not a county-precision case display.

records.summary: NMDOH reports 142 hantavirus pulmonary syndrome cases and 55 deaths in New Mexico between 1975 and 2025. Its reviewed page also listed seven confirmed cases in 2025 and one confirmed case in 2026.
records.geographyPrecision: State summary with selected county mentions on the official page
limitations: County mentions on the source page are not converted into a county-level map here.
The current-year line is a reviewed snapshot and may change on the NMDOH site.

records.summary: CDPH provides a hantavirus infection page with prevention guidance, an interactive story map, and a county-of-exposure PDF for reported California resident infections through 2024. This MVP links to those official products rather than extracting county values.
records.geographyPrecision: State page with linked county-of-exposure PDF
limitations: No California county values are copied into this MVP.
County of exposure is not the same thing as exact location of infection risk.

records.summary: ADHS sent a July 8, 2024 HAN advisory noting increased hantavirus activity and seven human HPS cases, including three deaths, reported from three counties as of July 1, 2024.
records.geographyPrecision: State alert with county count but no public county map in this project
limitations: HAN advisory values are an incident snapshot, not a complete current surveillance feed.
This project does not infer current Arizona case totals from older advisories.

records.summary: CDPHE maintains a hantavirus page with public prevention resources, provider reporting information, and a link to Colorado hantavirus data since 1993. This MVP points users to CDPHE for updated Colorado counts.
limitations: This record does not copy Colorado's current data table into the MVP.
A reservoir or exposure report does not establish exact ongoing risk at an address.

records.summary: CDC reports 890 laboratory-confirmed hantavirus disease cases in the United States from the start of surveillance in 1993 through the end of 2023. CDC states public data are reported by state only and county-level data cannot be provided to protect identities.
limitations: County-level data are not published here.
Counts may differ from provisional weekly NNDSS tables.

records.summary: Washington State Department of Health says hantavirus is notifiable in Washington and that typically one to five cases are reported each year. This record links to the official state page and epiTRENDS report rather than copying a county table.
records.geographyPrecision: State source link and annual range statement
limitations: Annual range statements are not a current case count.
No county risk map is inferred from state source text.

records.reportLabel: Government of Canada cumulative confirmed infections
records.summary: Government of Canada states that, as of May 1, 2026, the National Microbiology Laboratory had confirmed 168 hantavirus infections in Canada since active surveillance began in 1994. Older PHAC surveillance pages provide historical surveillance context.
records.status: Official national public health source linked
limitations: This is a national cumulative statement, not a live case feed.
Do not compare directly with U.S. HPS-only or provisional weekly tables without methodology notes.

records.summary: Argentina’s Ministry of Health reported 42 hantavirus cases notified so far in 2026 and 101 confirmed notifications since epidemiological week 27 of 2025, while describing national coordination after the MV Hondius cruise-associated outbreak.
limitations: Counts are an official national notification snapshot, not a live case feed.
No patient locations or local-risk map are inferred from the national update.
The broader 101 confirmed notifications since SE 27 of 2025 are retained in text only, not mixed into the 2026 year-to-date case field.
